_doc: Course registry — the one place a course is listed. tools/study/build-registry.js turns it into the STUDY array in site-chrome.js (menu, next-course chain) and the cards + JSON-LD in study.html. Order within a lane is the order here. Art history: dates shown on the timeline; technique: "course · N parts" is counted from the data.

card.text: the greek and roman gods and heroes in 60 paintings, sculptures, and vases, across 7 modules.
ukiyo-e from moronobu and harunobu to utamaro, sharaku, hokusai, hiroshige and kuniyoshi.
from watteau's fêtes galantes to david's revolution: sixty-seven works, 1700s–1800s
sixty-four works trace romanticism from fuseli, blake and goya to géricault, delacroix, turner, constable, friedrich and the hudson river school.
forty-nine works trace realism from the barbizon painters, courbet, millet and daumier to menzel, repin, homer, eakins and tanner.
how to recognize impressionism in 18 works, from manet and monet to morisot, degas and cassatt.
from seurat and cézanne to van gogh, gauguin, the nabis and the symbolists in 74 works, across 7 parts.
fifty-four works trace fauvism and early expressionism from matisse and derain to die brücke, the blue rider and vienna.
a short course on color for painters, from light and the eye to harmony, contrast and pigment, with historic plates, original diagrams and public-domain paintings.

a short course on how light and dark build form, from the value scale and light on form to light sources, edges and chiaroscuro, with plates from two classic public-domain drawing books and public-domain example works.
a short course on how painters arrange a picture, from the frame and value massing to balance, movement and unity, with plates from two classic public-domain books and public-domain example works.
a short course on what paintings are made of, from ancient pigments to binders, supports and grounds, with historic plates, original diagrams and public-domain works.
a short course on how oil and acrylic paint differ, from how each dries to how each ages, with historic plates, original diagrams and example paintings.
